title: Continuity on the union of two closed subsets
statement: Let $X,Y$ be topological spaces, let $A,B\subseteq X$ be closed subsets, and give all subsets their subspace topologies [def-kun-subspace-topology]. If a function $f:X\to Y$ is continuous on $A$ and continuous on $B$, then it is continuous on $A\cup B$.
